name: Rachel Bennett
military: Wyoming National Guard (the Wyoming Tribune Eagle reported she had previously worked at Wyoming Army National Guard Joint Force Headquarters and was a Guard veteran)
background: Had spent the previous 20 years as a Wyoming resident at the time of the 2022 Senate District 7 race. The Wyoming Tribune Eagle published a photograph of her at Wyoming Army National Guard Joint Force Headquarters, where it said she previously worked, and described her as a Guard veteran.
